correctness.rationale: The cap objective C(t)=c[(1-q)t+q∫_0^t S(u)du]+qΔ S(t) is correct for persistent Gamma frailty with shape k>0, scale μ/k, and a homogeneous comparator; the cost derivative is controlled by R_G=μ/[w+αw^(k+1)] and R_H=μ/[1+αe^x]. Both decline strictly from qμ, so both caps are zero exactly for M=μΔ/c≤1/q, otherwise uniquely positive. For x=μt>0 the difference has the sign of F=e^x-(1+x/k)^(k+1)-x/(kα); F(0)=0, F'(0)<0,F''(0)<0 and F'''=e^x-(1-1/k²)(1+x/k)^(k-2)>0 for every k>0, x≥0 (by elementary cases), implying one and only one additional positive crossing. The crossing transfers to the optimal-cap ordering. Independent bisection reproduced x_c=2.89311643092527 and M_c=19.0494719756656 for k=1,q=1/2, and distinct k,q checks; finite numerics do not prove uniqueness.
